test a robust trimmed‑mean combination to reduce influence of outlier models given unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Try a robust dba combination on the full pool, given the unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
try a robust weighted combination with softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over dba given unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust median might outperform mean/trimmed.
Test a weighted combination on the smaller, more stable pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a focused pool improves over dba.
Test a trimmed‑mean on the top‑7 pool to see if removing extreme forecasts improves over mean/weighted on the same subset, given the unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Test a robust weighted combination on the smaller, high‑variance pool (pool4) using softmax‑neg‑error weights to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over the current leader.
Test a per‑horizon best‑model weighted combination on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific dominance improves over the robust DBA.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.9238. Series context: trend strength 0.982 and seasonal strength 0.654; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.018); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.444.
